code_basis.name: Code basis
code_basis.summary: Climate zone 2A, no frost line, no snow load, seismic category A. Design wind 150 mph (Risk Cat II, Hillsborough County) — wind-borne debris provisions likely apply near the coast. 100-year 24-hour rainfall 11.3" (NOAA Atlas 14). At least 25 reported subsidence incidents within 5 miles (not proof of sinkhole risk at this parcel).

source.name: ASCE 7 / FBC county wind maps, IECC, NOAA Atlas 14 + FGS subsidence reports

source.note: Wind speed is the county-level Risk Category II value — confirm site-specific values (and exposure) with the ATC hazard maps for permit sets. Florida subsidence records are reported incidents, not verified sinkholes or a site-specific geotechnical assessment.
